paragraphs.text: Stardates is a non- Standard -legal bonus sheet associated with Star Trek . It is primarily themed around the Star Trek films , including the Narada incursion reality featuring characters as depicted in the J. J. Abrams reboot series. The bonus sheet is released alongside Star Trek on November 13, 2026.
Each stardates card is a recognizable reprint with artwork from the world of Star Trek, in a "movie poster"-style. There are 30 different stardates cards.
Non-foil stardates cards appear in Play Boosters and Collector Boosters . Traditional foil stardates cards appear only in Collector Boosters.
Stardates is available in Star Trek drafts on Magic: The Gathering Arena and will be legal in the Historic , Timeless , and Brawl formats.
